pricing.title: Pricing & Thresholds
pricing.description: Set electricity/fuel pricing and charging detection thresholds.

data_description.electricity_price_per_kwh: Price you pay per kWh of electricity.
data_description.fuel_price_per_litre: Price you pay per litre of fuel.
data_description.fuel_tank_size_litres: Total fuel tank capacity in litres. Used to calculate litres consumed from percentage change.
data_description.power_threshold_watts: Power draw (in Watts) above which a charging session is detected. Default: 50W.
data_description.debounce_seconds: Seconds the power must stay below threshold before a session is considered ended. Default: 120s.
